items.title: Annihilation of bounded local cohomology of a coherent complex by an ideal supported away from a specialization-stable subset
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the annihilation criterion for bounded local cohomology of a coherent complex in terms of a depth-and-dimension inequality on pairs of primes (author proposition at source lines 2993-3010, label proposition-annihilator-complex). The proof (source lines 3012-3164) is a long argument in the dualizing-complex formalism: it sets up the dualizing complex and its dimension function, runs the local duality spectral sequence in both directions to pass between annihilation by a supported ideal and the numerical inequality (proof lines 3020-3158), and closes with a minimality argument showing the critical local cohomology module is not annihilated by any ideal of the required support (proof lines 3158-3164). Both directions and the sharpness step are written out; the author's remark that the earlier proposition's proof should be read first is a reading suggestion, not an omission. H2.
